prompt: HTML5 img sizes attribute source-size-value allowed CSS functions
answer: The `sizes` attribute’s ``: - **May use CSS math functions**, including: - `calc()` - `min()` - `max()` - `clamp()` - **Must not use other CSS functions.** - The resulting value must be non-negative, and percentages are not allowed. Examples: ```html ``` The HTML Standard permits “math functions,” while WebKit specifically identifies `calc()`, `min()`, `max()`, and `clamp()` as supported functions. ([HTML Standard](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/dev/images.html), [WebKit](https://github.com/WebKit/WebKit/commit/0850a6e3f28536d1e54e16c3f8fa95c4254176cc))
